detail.readme_excerpt:
**An agent skill that draws diagrams as one self-contained HTML + SVG file, in your brand.
45 diagram types. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.** [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/cathrynlavery/diagram-design?style=flat-square&color=bf4520)](https://github.com/cathrynlavery/diagram-design/stargazers) [![skills.sh installs](https://skills.sh/b/cathrynlavery/diagram-design?style=flat-square)](https://skills.sh/cathrynlavery/diagram-design/diagram-design) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/cathrynlavery/diagram-design/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square&label=CI)](https://github.com/cathrynlavery/diagram-design/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Plugin version](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Fcathrynlavery%2Fdiagram-design%2Fmain%2F.claude-plugin%2Fplugin.json&query=%24.version&label=version&style=flat-square&color=555555)](CHANGELOG.md) [![MIT license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-555555?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) **[Website](https://diagramdesign.dev) · [Gallery](https://cathrynlavery.github.io/diagram-design/) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)** [Install](#install) · [What it makes](#what-it-makes) · [Quickstart](#quickstart) · [Match your brand](#onboarding-make-it-look-like-your-brand) · [Import](#import-from-drawio-mermaid-or-excalidraw) · [Export](#export-to-png--svg) · [Contributing](#contributing) npx skills add cathrynlavery/diagram-design


Ask your agent in plain words: - *"Make me an architecture diagram of my app: frontend, backend, database, Redis cache."* - *"I need a quadrant showing Q2 projects by impact vs effort."* - *"Give me a sequence of a bearer call with token refresh on 401."* - *"Onboard diagram-design to https://yoursite.com"* (pulls your palette and fonts so every diagram after this one matches your site) The agent picks the type, states its plan, and writes one `.html` file you can open by double-clicking. --- ## Install Works with any host that reads Agent Skills, including Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Q
